claims.claim: On October 13, 2026, Blockchain.com applied to the CFTC to register as a futures commission merchant and to become a designated contract market.
claims.episode_span: On October 13, Dallas-based Blockchain.com said it had applied to the U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission to register as a futures commission merchant and to become a designated contract market.
claims.source_title: Blockchain.com Files for CFTC Licenses to Offer Crypto Derivatives and Prediction Markets in the U.S.
claims.supporting_quote: The Dallas-based company announced the applications on Oct. 13, framing them as a step toward bringing futures, options and event contracts into a single app under federal oversight.

claims.claim: An FCM registration authorizes a firm to solicit and accept orders for futures and options and to hold customer funds, while a DCM designation lets a platform list contracts as an exchange.
claims.episode_span: A futures commission merchant may solicit and accept orders for futures and options and hold customer funds for those trades; a designated contract market may operate as an exchange that lists contracts.
claims.source_title: Blockchain.com Files for CFTC Licenses to Offer Crypto Derivatives and Prediction Markets in the U.S.
claims.supporting_quote: An FCM registration authorizes a firm to solicit and accept orders for futures and options and to hold customer funds for those trades, while a DCM designation lets a platform operate as an exchange that lists contracts for trading.

claims.claim: Blockchain.com already partnered with Polymarket to offer self-custodied prediction markets internationally and launched perpetual futures outside the United States.
claims.episode_span: Blockchain.com already offers self-custodied prediction markets outside the United States through a Polymarket partnership, and perpetual futures in eligible markets outside the United States.
claims.source_title: Blockchain.com Files for CFTC Licenses to Offer Crypto Derivatives and Prediction Markets in the U.S.
claims.supporting_quote: Blockchain.com has already partnered with Polymarket , which recently began rolling out its Protocol V2 upgrade with new ERC-1155 markets, to offer self-custodied prediction markets internationally.

claims.claim: Peter Smith said users should be able to manage digital assets, trade derivatives, and take positions on real-world events without jumping between apps.
claims.episode_span: Peter Smith, executive chairman, chief executive and co-founder, said users should be able to manage digital assets, trade derivatives and take positions on real-world events without jumping between apps.
claims.source_title: Blockchain.com Files for CFTC Licenses to Offer Crypto Derivatives and Prediction Markets in the U.S.
claims.supporting_quote: “Users should be able to manage their digital assets, trade derivatives, and take positions on real-world events easily, without jumping between different apps,” said Peter Smith, Blockchain.com’s executive chairman, CEO and co-founder.

claims.claim: Castanet reported Vernon mayoral incumbent Victor Cumming at 66 percent, Kelowna candidate Ron Cannan at 67 percent, and Vernon-Lumby Conservative Kevin Acton at 77 percent versus NDP Harwinder Sandhu at 19 percent.
claims.episode_span: Vernon incumbent Victor Cumming is at a 66 percent implied probability, and Kelowna candidate Ron Cannan is at 67 percent.
claims.source_title: Election betting reaches the Okanagan through online prediction markets, but expert warns odds aren't polls
claims.supporting_quote: Current market listings for the Vernon mayoral election show incumbent Victor Cumming with a 66 per cent implied chance of winning, while Kelowna mayoral market odds give candidate Ron Cannan a 67 per cent chance.

claims.claim: Castanet said neither Kalshi nor Polymarket is licensed to operate in Canada.
claims.episode_span: Castanet says neither platform is licensed to operate in Canada — Kalshi as a U.S.-regulated exchange, Polymarket offshore
claims.source_title: Election betting reaches the Okanagan through online prediction markets, but expert warns odds aren't polls
claims.supporting_quote: Neither platform is licensed to operate in Canada, as Kalshi is a U.S.-regulated exchange and Polymarket operates offshore, meaning Canadians betting on local races have none of the consumer protections of a regulated sportsbook.

claims.claim: Ross Hickey of UBC Okanagan said repeated bets by the same person can influence the price and that participants' prices are not voter probabilities.
claims.episode_span: Ross Hickey, an associate professor of economics in the faculty of management at UBC Okanagan, says the same person can bet repeatedly and move the price
claims.source_title: Election betting reaches the Okanagan through online prediction markets, but expert warns odds aren't polls
claims.supporting_quote: "There's no validation of the individuals who are participating in the market, so I can go in and make my max bet many times, and that can influence the price," said Ross Hickey, an associate professor of economics in the faculty of management at UBC Okanagan.

claims.claim: Castanet said the Vernon-Lumby market held just over $5,300 across four candidates and that a $4,000 bet would swing it, while Vancouver's mayoral market had over $272,000 across 13 candidates.
claims.episode_span: one $4,000 purchase would swing that Vernon-Lumby book, while the same sum would barely move Vancouver's mayoral market, which it puts at over $272,000 across 13 candidates.
claims.source_title: Election betting reaches the Okanagan through online prediction markets, but expert warns odds aren't polls
claims.supporting_quote: For example, the Vernon-Lumby MLA market holds just over $5,300 across four candidates. Because the order book is that thin, a single $4,000 bet on one candidate would drastically swing the odds.

claims.claim: A 2022 Journal of Sports Economics review of more than 600 spread-betting strategy implementations found predictable glitches too small to exploit profitably and argued for a |z| greater than 3 hurdle.
claims.episode_span: A 2022 review in the Journal of Sports Economics gathered more than six hundred implementations of such strategies
claims.source_title: Efficient Spread Betting Markets: A Literature Review
claims.supporting_quote: We review over 600 strategy implementations and find that market efficiency and systematic misperceptions are not mutually exclusive per se.

claims.claim: A Journal of Prediction Markets study of English football from 2002 to 2006 found a positive favourite-longshot bias on home and away odds, a negative longshot bias on draws, and a higher return from betting draws than home or away.
claims.episode_span: Home odds and away odds carried a positive favourite-longshot bias. Draw odds went the other way, a negative longshot bias.
claims.source_title: EFFICIENCY IN BETTING MARKETS: EVIDENCE FROM ENGLISH FOOTBALL
claims.supporting_quote: We find evidence of a positive favourite-longshot bias for both home odds and away odds. Draw odds are instead characterized by a negative longshot bias.
